items.title: Marriott Bonvoy Sign-Ins Were Down for Hours
items.summary: Marriott’s website and app briefly blocked loyalty member log-ins Tuesday. The company says the outage wasn’t a cyberattack. United Airlines and many non-travel companies have suffered various tech disruptions in recent days.

items.title: Kayak Adds 28 AI Features, Letting Travelers Ask for the Cheapest Dates to Fly
items.summary: Booking’s metasearch company is betting that live prices and comparison tools, not just conversations, will keep travelers from starting their search on Google or a chatbot.

items.title: Skift Aviation Forum 2026: Airlines Contend with Costs, Double Down on What Works
items.summary: Disruptions to the longstanding status quo across product, technology, loyalty, and operations are fragmenting customer engagement and putting pressure on airlines and other aviation companies to make decisions today that will impact the next 10 years.

items.title: Asia Slump Drives Seventh Straight Month of Falling U.S. Overseas Arrivals
items.summary: A 12.6% drop from Asia fueled the seventh straight month of U.S. inbound travel declines, more evidence that the U.S. is losing ground as other countries compete for the same long-haul travelers.

items.title: Booking Holdings’ AI Agent Vayo Can Now Reserve Flights and Hotels
items.summary: Booking Holdings’ newest AI agent can now transact to book hotels, flights, and other trip arrangements. But Vayo's ability to complete reservations depends on supplier sites.

items.title: Accor to Buy Out Ennismore Partners for $1.8 Billion — No IPO for Now
items.summary: Accor is paying up to own its fastest-growing business outright rather than list it now. The valuation is more than double what Ennismore was worth four years ago.

items.title: The Multi-Billion-Dollar Loyalty Mirage: Why We Still Don’t Know What Airline Cards Really Earn
items.summary: United CEO Scott Kirby says investors overestimate airline credit-card profits, but filings from United, Delta, and American show substantial loyalty-program cash flows without establishing what the bank deals actually earn.

items.title: Skift Commerce Summit 2026: Balancing Trust, Access, and Control in the Traveler Relationship
items.summary: Travel companies are now being forced to decide which parts of the customer relationship to pursue directly while allowing and even enabling intermediaries to have more control of the journey.
